items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Louis Jordan was still with Chick Webb, but he came down there and listened.

ctx.x: If you'd a little more luck, you could have gotten what Louis Jordan did.
Let me tell you a funny
about that. I was Louis Jordan's inspiration too. We got down, in the latter part of '37, a club downtown called the Club Afrique, right across from the Harlander (phonetic spelling) Hotel.
